title: Boot reconstruction lacks restart witnesses for authority mismatch, eligibility exclusions, legacy shape without its record, and Stop during an attempt
outcome: src/tests/engram_begin_boot.rs also covers: (a) a saved begin-unknown or pre-fix head whose retained evaluate's connection or settings differ from the current target schedules nothing and keeps its explicit hold; (b) the boot pass leaves an interrupted head, an operator-paused one, disabled control and an unknown transcript position as they are; (c) a head with the pre-fix shape but no begin_reconstruct record keeps its earlier cold-restore and bind routes; (d) a Stop or pause between the replayed evaluate and the begin preparation of a reconstruction ends it without a begin.
acceptance: Boot reconstruction lacks restart witnesses for authority mismatch, eligibility exclusions, legacy shape without its record, and Stop during an attempt is done
